board: Arduino Nano 33 BLE Sense, Arduino mbed core

requirements.requirement: The signal on pin D5 must have a frequency of 1 kHz.
The signal on pin D5 must have a duty cycle of 25%.
The PWM signal on D5 must start automatically after reset without any serial input or button press.
The PWM signal on D5 must be stable (correct frequency and duty cycle) within 50 ms after reset.
